result.title: CivilBench: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Multimodal Information Integration in Civil Engineering
result.summary: Artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs), is increasingly applied in civil and structural engineering for disaster assessment, structural analysis, and engineering decision support. However, the extent to which current VLMs possess the reasoning capabilities required for reliable engineering judgments remains unclear. In this work, we introduce CivilBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLMs in civil engineering and disaster-related scenarios. CivilBench covers three major task families: Sequential Reasoning, Image-based Structural Understanding, and Open-world Understanding, encompassing numerical reasoning, structural damage assessment, risk inference, causal analysis, and repair planning. The benchmark is constructed through a systematic pipeline of domain-specific data collection, engineering-oriented captioning, expert annotation, question design, and quality verification. Evaluation of representative state-of-the-art VLMs reveals substantial limitations in domain-specific reasoning, with Sequential Reasoning emerging as a major bottleneck, particularly when models must infer numerical relationships from sparse structured observations. Further experiments show that numerical priors and external knowledge can alleviate these limitations, although their effectiveness depends on the model's ability to reliably interpret and use the available evidence. CivilBench provides a capability-oriented testbed for identifying reasoning limitations and evaluating progress toward reliable AI-assisted engineering decision-making. The benchmark will be publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/traceuryuan/CivilBench.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CivilBench，一个面向土木与灾害场景的 VLM 多模态信息整合基准，覆盖序列推理、结构图像理解与开放世界理解三类任务，经领域数据采集、工程化描述、专家标注与质检流程构建，并评测多个代表性 VLM。
AI.relevance_reason: 结果显示序列推理是主要瓶颈，模型难以从稀疏结构化观测中推断数值关系，且数值先验与外部知识的收益取决于证据解读是否可靠，这与 VLM 能否保留并使用任务必需的视觉细节、如何筛选证据的问题相关，可供核查；但属领域专用评测，未涉及 latent 状态生成机制。
